item.description: A final call regarding Bangladesh's T20 World Cup 2026 participation, and particularly the team travelling to India, would be taken on January 21, ESPNCricinfo reported on Sunday (January 18). According to the report, the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) was told of this deadline by the International Cricket Council (ICC) during their discussions at Dhaka on Saturday (January 17).
